title: A commentary on Crabtree’s “H is for human and how (not) to evaluate qualitative research in HCI”
titleZh: 对 Crabtree《H is for human and how (not) to evaluate qualitative research in HCI》的评论
summaryZh: 这篇评论针对 Crabtree 的《H is for human and how (not) to evaluate qualitative research in HCI》，讨论 HCI 领域定性研究应当如何评估、以及哪些做法不宜用于评估。原文正文未提供更多细节，没有可引用的样本量、指标或实证数据。
